subject: Vendor kickoff & procurement timeline coordination for QuickSafe
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@quicksafe.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.r@quicksafe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor kickoff & procurement timeline coordination for QuickSafe

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the conversation yesterday. We're excited to get QuickSafe onboarded and want to run a short procurement kickoff to align on: procurement steps, security evidence timelines (SOC2 / pen test), legal redlines process, and technical handoffs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 7 Dec, 10:00–11:00 AM (preferred)
- Wed 8 Dec, 1:00–2:00 PM

Agenda (30–60 min depending on attendees):
- Intros & goals (5)
- Procurement checklist walk-through (10)
- Security artifacts & timeline (10)
- Technical access & integration plan (10)
- Next steps & owners (5)

I’ve attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and a redlines_request_template.docx to make it easier for your procurement and legal teams. If you want to include your security lead (Raj) and legal contact, please loop them in and tell us which slot works.

If those times don't work, share 2 alternative windows and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 22KB); redlines_request_template.docx (DOCX, 9KB)

From: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@quicksafe.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.r@quicksafe.com>, Raj Patel <raj.p@quicksafe.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff & procurement timeline coordination for QuickSafe

Thanks Neha — quick note from procurement. We can do Tue 7 Dec but our security lead Raj needs the SOC2 report and our cloud isolation questions answered before we have the technical deep-dive. Can you confirm where we can access: 

- Current SOC 2 report (date & scope)
- Pen test summary (if available)
- Encryption/KMS approach for customer keys in Private deployments

Also, FYI our legal will want to see a sample SOW and proposed payment milestones. I looped Raj on this thread.

If you can share those docs ahead, Tue 7 Dec 10:00–11:00 AM PST works. If not, Wed 8 Dec 1–2 PM is our fallback.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Sr. Procurement Manager, QuickSafe
e.zhang@quicksafe.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <e.zhang@quicksafe.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff & procurement timeline coordination for QuickSafe

Emily — I can take the technical portion. Quick notes on artifacts I’ll bring to the meeting:
- SOC2: latest PCAOB third-party attestation, coverage through June 2026 (I’ll attach pointer)
- Pen test: executive summary + remediation tracker (summary only)
- Private deployment KMS options: customer-managed KMS (GCP/AWS/Azure) + HSM option; will have a short slide for tradeoffs

If Raj wants pre-read, I can share the executive summaries by EOD Monday. Also recommend we reserve 60 minutes in case legal/tech questions push beyond 30.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00

Forwarding our internal note — quick conflict on Tue morning; most of leadership is in a standing all-hands. Could we move to

- Tue 7 Dec, 3:00–4:00 PM PST OR
- Thu 9 Dec, 9:00–10:00 AM PST

We prefer a 60-minute slot to include our legal counsel for the SOW discussion. I attached a very rough quicksaf eprocurement-draft-timeline.xlsx for alignment on milestones.

Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff & procurement timeline coordination for QuickSafe

Tom — thanks for the heads up. Thu 9 Dec, 9:00–10:00 AM PST works for our team and gives Ben time to circulate the security pre-reads. I’ve scheduled a 60-minute meeting and created a Google Meet: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=neha-qskickoff-20261209.

Action items before the meeting:
- Ben: share SOC2 exec summary + pen test summary by EOD Tue 7 Dec
- Neha: share sample SOW & payment milestone template (attached)
- QuickSafe: confirm legal attendee + list any must-have contract terms ahead of the meeting

Attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redlines_request_template.docx. Also linking the draft procurement timeline you included: qs-procurement-draft-timeline.xlsx.

If anything changes, reply all — otherwise we’ll see you Thu 9 Dec at 9am PST.

Thanks — Neha
